programme.title: South Park: Pandémie

programme.title: South Park: Pandémie 2 - La Terreur
programme.desc: Les enfants et Craig se retrouvent paumés dans la jungle péruvienne. Depuis le renvoi des musiciens péruviens, les États-Unis sont attaqués par des cochons d'Inde géants que Randy filme en pleine panique avec sa nouvelle caméra.

programme.title: South Park: À propos d'hier soir
programme.desc: Barack Obama vient de remporter les élections présidentielles face à McCain. Tout le pays est divisé entre les gagnants, dont Randy, qui font la fête ; et les perdants, dont Ike, qui sont persuadés que la fin du monde est proche.

programme.title: South Park: Elementary School Musical
programme.desc: Les garçons se rendent compte qu'ils ne sont plus les plus cools de l'école. Stan réalise qu'il pourrait perdre Wendy s'il ne change rien à cette situation !

programme.title: South Park: L'Impunissable
programme.desc: Les enfants Goth de l'école élémentaire de South Park ont de la concurrence. Butters est persuadé d'avoir vu un vampire à l'école, mais personne ne l'écoute.

programme.title: South Park: La Bague
programme.desc: Kenny emmène sa petite amie à un concert des Jonas Brothers, pensant que celui-ci le mènera à son cœur et à d'autres parties du corps.

programme.title: South Park: Le Coon
programme.desc: Persuadé que la ville de South Park a besoin d'un super-héros, Cartman devient, la nuit venue, Le Coon.

programme.title: South Park: Margaritaville
programme.desc: Randy annonce qu'il a une solution pour sortir le pays de son désastre économique.

programme.title: South Park: Mange, prie et froute
programme.desc: Les enfants sont surexcités car en rentrant chez eux ils verront la suite d'un épisode de Terrence et Phillip.

programme.title: South Park: Bite au nez de poisson
programme.desc: Jimmy en veut à Cartman de s'attribuer le mérite d'une blague qu'il a lui-même créée et qui a beaucoup de succès dans tout le pays. Mais Kanye West est très énervé car il n'en comprend pas la chute.

programme.title: South Park: Le Derby de Pinewood
programme.desc: Stan participe avec son père Randy à une course de petites voitures en bois, le Derby de Pinewood.

programme.title: South Park: Barbobèse
programme.desc: Butters et un petit groupe de recrues rejoignent Cartman dans son rêve de vivre sur l'île du crâne où se trouve un trésor enterré.

programme.title: South Park: Vedettes mortes
programme.desc: Des fantômes de célébrités récemment décédées tourmentent Ike. Il est mort de peur et le stress pourrait bien le tuer.

programme.title: South Park: La Meilleure Gagneuse de Butters
programme.desc: Butters découvre une activité lucrative après avoir pour la première fois fait payer un baiser. Mais le sergent Yates décide de lutter très activement contre la prostitution.

programme.title: South Park: Catch
programme.desc: Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny découvrent leur nouvelle passion dans la vie après être allés à un combat de catch et se dépêchent de signer pour le club de lutte.

programme.title: South Park: Putain de baleines
programme.desc: Stan fête son anniversaire avec sa famille à l'aquarium de Denver où ils vont pouvoir nager avec les dauphins.

programme.title: South Park: Fiottes
programme.desc: Les enfants vont se battre pour que le festival Harley ne ruine pas leur week-end à South Park !

programme.title: South Park: Danse avec les Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: Cartman prend le contrôle des annonces du matin à l'école. Grâce à cela, il veut devenir la voix du changement !

programme.title: South Park: Pipi
programme.desc: Stan, Cartman, Kyle, Kenny, Butters et Jimmy se rendent au parc aquatique pour une journée pleine de fun. Malheureusement, les choses se passent autrement et ils ont rendez-vous avec la mort.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tous les grands scientifiques des Etats-Unis se réunissent pour plancher sur une épidémie étrange: l'addiction au sexe. Il semblerait que les hommes riches et puissants veulent soudainement coucher avec des tonnes de femmes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après avoir lu le livre controversé de J.D. Salinger, 'L'Attrape-cœurs' Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny se lancent à leur tour dans l'écriture d'un roman. Mais la mère de Stan découvre leur prose.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le restaurant préféré de Cartman a fermé et laissé place à une pharmacie qui vend du cannabis médicinal. Randy essaie alors désespérément d'obtenir une prescription médicale pour pouvoir s'en procurer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny découvrent Facebook et les relations entre 'amis' virtuels. Malheureusement pour lui, Kyle accepte de devenir ami avec la mauvaise personne.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cet été, l'heure n'est pas à la détente mais à la compétition. Jimmy et ses amis handicapés mettent tout en oeuvre pour être les champions du camp de vacances.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eric Cartman rêve de devenir pilote de Nascar et est prêt à tout pour y parvenir. Comme il est persuadé qu'il faut être pauvre et stupide pour exceller dans cette discipline, il va tenter de se débarrasser de tout son argent et de ses neurones.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pour lutter contre l'invasion des habitants de New Jersey, la ville de South Park se mobilise et en vient à faire appel à Oussama Ben Laden.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: À la demande de Wendy Testaburger, Stan accepte de ranger son casier avec l'aide d'un groupe de 'spécialistes'.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon et ses amis sont disposés à aider les victimes de la marée noire provoquée par BP suite à un accident de forage dans le Golfe du Mexique.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Emmenés par Mystérion, les super-héros doivent résoudre la crise du Golfe et arrêter Cthulhu. Mais le Coon a d'autres idées en tête.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon se révèle être plus infâme encore que le Seigneur maléfique Cthulhu! Alors que le Coon punit ses anciens amis, Kenny tente de vivre avec le fardeau que représente son super-pouvoir.
programme.sub-title: Le Coon contre le Coon et sa bande

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: C'est la pagaille dans la vie de Stan, à la maison comme à l'école, à cause de l'obsession de Randy pour les chaînes culinaires. Et cela affecte même Sharon qui, se sentant délaissée, décide de faire du sport.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle n'ayant pas lu les petites lettres de son contrat, il est kidnappé par Apple, qui a de grands projets pour lui. Il appartient aux garçons de le sauver.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après que l'on se soit moqué de l'Allemagne lors des récompenses pour la comédie, les Allemands construisent une machine à rires: Funnybot. Cependant, ses projets pour l'humanité ne sont pas très réjouissantes.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a Warlord lookalike.
programme.sub-title: OVERWHELMING! THE NAVY'S FIGHTING WEAPONS, THE PACIFISTAS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far deadlier foe comes looking for a fight.
programme.sub-title: AN EVEN STRONGER ENEMY APPEARS! THE BATTLE AXE-CARRYING SENTOMARU

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro's barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.
programme.sub-title: ADMIRAL KIZARU'S FIERCE ASSAULT / THE STRAW HATS FACE CERTAIN DEATH!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?
programme.sub-title: ELIMINATED FRIENDS - THE FINAL DAY OF THE STRAW HAT CREW

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a Warlord of the Sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!
programme.sub-title: FEUDAL ERA SIDE STORY / BOSS LUFFY APPEARS AGAIN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!
programme.sub-title: FEUDAL ERA SIDE STORY / DEFEAT THRILLER COMPANY'S TRAP!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man's amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!
programme.sub-title: LANDING! THE ALL-FEMALE ISLAND, AMAZON LILY

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: An army of scantily-clad women warriors want to investigate Luffy's family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.
programme.sub-title: HURRY BACK TO YOUR FRIENDS! THE MAIDEN ISLAND ADVENTURE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The women chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she's about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!
programme.sub-title: EVERYONE FALLS IN LOVE! PIRATE EMPRESS HANCOCK

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's search for a seaworthy vessel leads to a "drop-in" on the Snake Princess during the royal bathing hour. The view is world-class, but it might turn the rubber-man to stone!
programme.sub-title: THE SECRET HIDDEN ON THE BACKS / LUFFY AND THE SNAKE PRINCESS MEET

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Boa Hancock makes Luffy mad when she turns Margaret into a statue. The Snake Princess may have bitten off more than she can chew by challenging the captain of the Straw Hats!
programme.sub-title: HEARTLESS JUDGMENT! MARGARET IS TURNED TO STONE!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Snake Princess pits Luffy's Gum-Gum abilities against the incredible Haki power of her serpentine sisters in a fight to the death. Will Luffy survive long enough to save his statuesque friends?
programme.sub-title: A DIFFICULT FIGHT FOR LUFFY! THE SNAKE SISTERS' HAKI POWER!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy kicks his attack mode into Second Gear to save a precious statue, and the snake sisters start to feel the Straw Hat heat. At the battle's climax, Luffy makes an impression on his opponents.
programme.sub-title: ALL-OUT SPECIAL POWER BATTLE!! GUM-GUM VS. SNAKE-SNAKE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: News of Luffy's run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?
programme.sub-title: HANCOCK'S CONFESSION-- THE SISTERS' ABHORRENT PAST

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty Kuja women eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him a safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.
programme.sub-title: SAVING ACE! THE NEXT STOP: THE GREAT PRISON

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Boa Hancock's illness threatens to sabotage Luffy's rescue mission. However, the Snake Princess just can't say "no" to the rubber-man, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.
programme.sub-title: LOVE IS A HURRICANE! LOVE-LOVE HANCOCK

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!
programme.sub-title: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! THE SCIENCE OF WEATHER AND THE MECHANICAL ISLAND

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji's refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of girlish hearts.
programme.sub-title: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! AN ISLAND OF GIANT BIRDS AND A PINK PARADISE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!
programme.sub-title: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! BRIDGING THE ISLANDS AND VICIOUS VEGETATION!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!
programme.sub-title: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! A NEGATIVE PRINCESS AND THE KING OF DEMONS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace's execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!
programme.sub-title: A DEADLY INFILTRATION! THE UNDERWATER PRISON IMPEL DOWN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who's going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There's no love lost between the former foes, but they'd better work together if they want to survive.
programme.sub-title: A REUNION IN HELL?! THE MAN WHO ATE THE CHOP-CHOP FRUIT!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down's Crimson Hell!
programme.sub-title: BREAK THROUGH THE CRIMSON HELL! BUGGY'S CHAOS-INDUCING PLAN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren't careful in Impel Down's Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubber-man might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison's putrid warden!
programme.sub-title: THE STRONGEST MAN IN THE PRISON! POISON MAN MAGELLAN APPEARS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!
programme.sub-title: A SPECIAL PRESENTATION RELATED TO THE MOVIE / A GOLD LION'S AMBITION ON THE MOVE

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In one of the most bizarre love stories to come across Dr. Phil’s stage, now Dr. Phil uncovers a massive secret that changes everything with Ryan and Suzanne. Here is the conclusion to a fascinating tale of lies, deception and emotional extortion! Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Questionable Will & A Suspect Twin: Is This The Craziest Catfish Story Of Them All Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristi says daughter Haley has always been a compulsive liar. She says lies Haley has told are that she was a contestant on American Idol, rapper Eminem is her father and she’s diagnosed paranoid schizophrenic. Now she says she's 9 months pregnant. Part 1
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Is Delusional And Lying About Being 9 Months Pregnant Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Crystal accuses her ex-boyfriend, Anthony, of sexually assaulting their 3-year-old daughter. Crystal says she has proof confirming Anthony as the monster she says he is. Anthony says Crystal is “crazy and a liar.” Can Dr. Phil expose the truth? Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accusations Of Lies, Child Sex Abuse, And Stalking Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Courtney claims her former friend Amie has lied about being pregnant three times and losing five babies total. To uncover the truth, Dr. Phil producers spoke with the county coroner, the hospital, and tracked down one of the supposed fathers-to-be. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accused Of Faking Multiple Pregnancies And Baby Deaths: Is She Scamming Men Or A Victim Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Inside the “California House of Horrors” where 13 children were starved, chained and abused by their own parents. Family, neighbors and childhood friends speak about the tragedy. Cleveland kidnap survivor Michelle Knight sends a message to the children.
programme.sub-title: Inside The California House Of Horror: 13 Children Rescued After Being Shackled And Abused

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Terrie says daughter Kelly accused her of molesting her 5-yr-old granddaughter. Terrie says Kelly attended a week-long desert retreat that affected her personality: Kelly says she saw aliens on the retreat who may have abducted, raped & impregnated her.
programme.sub-title: An Unspeakable Accusation: My Daughter Believes I Molested My Granddaughter

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Autumn says she was called a “crazy, jealous girlfriend” after video of her keying her ex-boyfriend’s car went viral. She says ex-boyfriend, D’Andre, choked her, head-butted her and sexually assaulted her; D’Andre denies sexually assaulting her. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Arrested For Keying Ex-Boyfriend's Car Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kalan says Giovanni made a major shift in his identity two days after he asked her to marry him. The army veteran changed his persona to superhero, wears a mask, and only answers to “Goose Wayne Batman.” Kalan won't walk down the aisle with a masked man.
programme.sub-title: My Fiance Believes He's A Superhero

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mom Anita & daughter Alexa say an incident 3 years ago left the family shattered: an ex-husband, a loaded gun, a little boy caught between parents & now an ex-mother-in-law who says her son is blameless & is going to court for grandson visitation rights.
programme.sub-title: My Grandson's Father Nearly Killed Us And His Mother Is Battling Us In Court

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The disappearance of Connecticut mom of 5, Jennifer Dulos has captivated the media. Dr. Phil's team of experts analyze circumstances surrounding her disappearance, including Jennifer Dulos' estranged husband, Fotis, & his girlfriend, Michelle Troconis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Logan, 30, desperately needs help. Mom Tracy says he has gone from a productive computer science engineer to a shell of a human being: no motivation, rarely eats, & can barely function to take care of his basic hygiene needs. Can Logan get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: McKinley, 18, says she decided 5 years ago she never wanted to see her dad, Cory, again, after learning he went to jail on two counts of sexual battery of a minor! She says her dad is a violent, dangerous, "psychopath". Cory says he's never abused anyone.
programme.sub-title: Sex Abuse Allegations Ruined My Run For Congress And My Relationship With My Daughter Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melissa, 26, left home without warning & flew 2,000 miles across the country, leaving behind a note that said, "One day, Dr. Phil will be able to help me." The family says she hadn't "been herself." Melissa says she's ready to tell why she vanished.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery Of Melissa: Why Did She Vanish? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Jenaye posted an emotional video online about uncovering her husband James's infidelity she never imagined it would go viral. Discovering James slept with his hairstylist on their fifth anniversary, Jenaye says divorce might be the best option.
programme.sub-title: My Husband's Cheating Went Viral Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Monica's old life: English teacher, marathon runner, happy. Now 90 lbs. and no solid food with a C-diff diagnosis, she chains herself to bed to avoid sleepwalking or binge eating. It's a full-time job for mom, Stephanie; friend Breanna suspects enabling.
programme.sub-title: Painfully Ill: Can Monica Be Saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For the past 2 years Nancy has been in an online relationship with "Shaun" she says is an honest and loving man. Her son Darcy says Nancy doesn't even know what he looks like! Nancy is adamant she is not being scammed in this catfish story of online love.
programme.sub-title: Talk To Dr. Phil Or We're Done Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Summer Wells, 5, vanished from her Tennessee home, June 15, 2021. Parents Don & Candus claim abduction; online bullies say the opposite. Don & Candus meet with Scott Rouse & Greg Hartley, body language experts who work with the FBI, police and military.
programme.sub-title: The Disappearance of Summer Wells Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jenaye comes face-to-face for the first time with the woman her husband, James, slept with on their fifth wedding anniversary. The woman, Chelsey, who is also James's former hairstylist, tells her side of the story. Will Jenaye believe Chelsey's claims?
programme.sub-title: The Husband, The Wife And The Mistress Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with pregnant teen, Sara, who says she’s not addicted--her sister is a bad influence. Dr. Phil learns she and sister Sadie did cocaine the night before the show. Dr. Phil shows video of addicted babies and issues an ultimatum. Part 2
programme.sub-title: Pregnant And Abusing Drugs: The Ultimatum Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sandra and ex-husband Joey admit they’re in a bitter custody battle. Sandra and Joey’s mudslinging has frightening accusations, but are they telling the truth? See what happens when these parents are offered polygraph and drug tests. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Bitter Custody Battle: Claims Of Poison In Ice Cream, A Child Wrapped In A Garbage Bag And Inappropriate Touching: What Will The Polygraph Reveal Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melissa says Destoni, 14, is an aggressive, violent bully. She's chased her sister with a butcher knife, yells at teachers in the hallways but Destoni crossed a line when she threatened to shoot her teacher and other students, causing suspension. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Expelled, Handcuffed & Violent: My 14-Year-Old Daughter Is Out Of Control Pt. 1
